summary: Completed testing of Smart Assignment feature (Assignation Intelligente). All 8 test cases passed - 6 backend API tests (100%) and 8 frontend UI tests (100%). The feature allows unassigned interventions to be visible to all technicians with 'Disponible' badge and 'Accepter cette mission' button.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /interventions/{id}/claim endpoint correctly handles race conditions with double-check on technicien_id=None
Frontend InterventionCard component properly shows isAvailable state with amber styling and pulse animation
GET /interventions/today correctly includes unassigned interventions for technicians via $or query
409 Conflict response correctly returned when trying to claim already-assigned intervention
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed interventions during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart Assignment feature fully tested and working. Key endpoints: GET /interventions/available (returns unassigned), POST /interventions/{id}/claim (assigns to tech), GET /interventions/today (includes available for techs). Frontend shows 'Disponible' badge with amber styling and 'Accepter cette mission' button for unassigned interventions.

test_1_backend_create_without_technician.description: POST /api/interventions with technicien_id=null creates available intervention

test_2_backend_get_available.evidence: Returns list of interventions with technicien_id=None and statut=planifiee

test_3_backend_today_includes_available.description: GET /api/interventions/today for tech includes available interventions
test_3_backend_today_includes_available.evidence: Tech sees both assigned and unassigned interventions in today's list

test_4_backend_claim_success.description: POST /api/interventions/{id}/claim assigns intervention to claiming tech
test_4_backend_claim_success.evidence: Returns 200 with technicien_id set to claiming user's ID

test_5_backend_claim_conflict_409.evidence: Returns 409 Conflict with message about intervention already taken

test_6_frontend_disponible_badge.description: Available interventions display 'Disponible' badge and orange border
test_6_frontend_disponible_badge.evidence: Found 7 'Disponible' badges, 6 cards with border-l-amber-500 styling, pulse animation on badge

test_7_frontend_accepter_button.description: 'Accepter cette mission' button calls /claim and refreshes list
test_7_frontend_accepter_button.evidence: Button click triggers claim API, shows 'Mission acceptée ! Elle vous est maintenant assignée.' toast

test_8_frontend_after_claim_no_badge.description: After claim, intervention no longer has 'Disponible' badge
test_8_frontend_after_claim_no_badge.evidence: Claimed intervention 'Test Intervention Tech' shows only 'Planifiée' badge, no orange border, no Accept button
